component: Virtual folder properties saved-state guard and regression test

quotes.text: Search online should still be checked after reopening

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dialog restores onlineSearch from the virtual-folder wrapper before checking selected server support. The updated guard clears the checkbox only when no selected server has truthy offline support; otherwise it preserves the loaded value. Accepting writes the property back through the wrapper. The new test directly checks enabled/checked across accept and reopen for an IMAP-backed virtual folder created with true. It does not directly cover false, offline-only transitions or an actual server search.
title: Online-capable folders preserve the saved Search online checkbox value
